remarks: Perfectly positioned on the Stamford/Darien border, this sun-filled townhouse in The Village at Maple Point offers the ideal blend of space, convenience, and low-maintenance living. The home includes an updated kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and breakfast nook. The spacious living/dining area opens to a private balcony, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Upstairs offers two spacious bedrooms and two renovated full baths, including a primary suite with double closets, whirlpool tub, stall shower, and double vanity. The versatile third-floor loft is ideal for a home office, gym, third bedroom, or media room. Attached one-car garage, super low HOA, and pet friendly. Just 0.5 miles to Glenbrook Train Station and 1 mile from Noroton Heights station for an easy NYC commute. Easy access to I-95 as well for a commuters dream. Privately situated within the community, setting away from road traffic.
